text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service--

BANGLADESH, Feb 25 - Chittagong - 21 Vessels in port of which 4 containers, 3 food grain, 1 24 hours, 3 tankers, 5 general cargo, 1 cement, 3 fertiliser, 1 other vessel. 23 Vessels due by 4/3 of which 12 containers, 1 food grain, 3 survey vessels, 2 cement clinker, 2 24 hours, 2 tankers, 1 for scraping. 3-4 Days berthing delay expected for general cargo vessels.

INDIA, Feb 25 - Bombay - No labour problems. Four vessels loading at berth, 18 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage. 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 10 waiting to discharge, 1 bunkering, 2 under repair, 1 awaiting orders. Berthing delays, container vessels 1-2 days, bulkers 8-10 days, general cargo 2-3 days. Calcutta - Six vessels loading at berth, 10 discharging at berth, 2 vessels bunkering. 18 Vessels due (2 coking coal, 6 products tankers, 2 pulses, 5 containers, 1 petcoke, 2 logs).

Cochin - No labour problems. Four vessels discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchor to discharge, 1 bunkering, 1 tug and 1 small vessel at dry-dock and 1 bulker at shipyard jetty for repair/fitting. 1 Vessel awaiting orders, 8 due with up to 1 days delay expected. Chennai (Madras) - No labour problems. One vessel loading at berth, 9 discharging at berth, 7 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 dredger dry-docked. 28 Vessels due (5 general cargo, 6 coal, 12 containers, 1 fertiliser, 4 edible oil) with following delays, coal/coke 3-4 days, fertiliser/others 2-3 days, scrap 4-5 days, no delays for containers/iron ore.

Mormugao - No labour problems. Two vessels loading at berth, 1 loading at anchorage, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting to discharge, 2 under repair/dry-docked, 1 awaiting orders, 12 due with 4-5 days delay expected.

Kandla - Five vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 1 discharging in stream, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 tankers, 23 vessels waiting. 19 Vessels due with 6-7 days delay expected. Mangalore - No labour problems. Five vessels loading/discharging at berth, 1 awaiting berth, 1 under arrest, 16 due with up to 1 days delay expected.

Jawaharlal Nehru - No. 1 and 2 bulk berths will be reserved for wheat vessels until the end of April fertiliser and other bulk vessels should expect extra berthing delays. No labour problems. One tanker/iron ore vessel loading at berth, 1 fertiliser/raw materials/food grain vessel discharging at berth, 1 tanker/iron ore waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 tanker/iron ore due with 2-3 days berthing delay expected. Paradip - No labour problems.
Two vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 5 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting to discharge, 4 due with 3-4 days delay expected.

Tuticorin - No labour problems. Four vessels loading at berth, 2 loading at anchorage, 5 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting to discharge, 2 under repair/dry-docked, 4 due with 1-2 days delay expected.

Visakhapatnam - No labour problems. Seven vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load at inner harbour berth. 19 Vessels due (exporters - 1 iron ore, 1 wire coils, 1 bars, 1 pig-iron, 1 thermal coal, 1 alumina, 1 chrome, 1 granite blocks. Importers - 1 mop, 5 coking coal, 1 coke, 1 general cargo, 1 containers, 1 caustic soda, 1 iron ore) with following delays expected, iron ore/wire coils/bars/chrome/granite blocks/mop/coke/iron ore 7-8 days, pig iron 4-5 days, general cargo 3-4 days, thermal coal/alumina/coking coal/containers/caustic soda up to 1 day.

PAKISTAN, Feb 24 - Karachi - Five vessels loading at berth (rice, general cargo, mol). 3 Container vessels loading/discharging, 8 discharging at berth (general cargo, urea, dap). 4 Rice vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 14 waiting at anchorage to discharge (containers, fertiliser, tankers, general cargo). 3 Vessels awaiting orders, 6 due with following delays, general cargo 1-2 days, rice loaders 12 days, fertiliser vessels 46 days. Port Qasim - Two rice vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth (lpg, wheat, fuel oil).
2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (soya bean oil, fuel oil). 7 Rice vessels waiting at anchorage to load.

SRI LANKA, Feb 25 - Colombo - No labour problems. Six vessels loading at berth (3 containers, 3 essential services). 24 Discharging at berth (4 bagged sugar, 14 containers, 1 bulk lpg, 1 bagged fertiliser, 1 bagged onions, 1 bagged gypsum, 2 general cargo). 10 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (1 bagged flour, 6 containers, 1 bulk cement, 2 general cargo). 2 Vessels bunkering, 2 under repair/dry-docked, 6 awaiting orders, 8 due (5 containers, 3 general cargo) with 2 days delay expected for conventional vessels. Galle - No vessels operating. Trincomalee - One vessel discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth.
